note: The four survivor walk strips, as generated. Each is nine 64x64 frames side by side; frame 0 is the input (the pack's rest view, textures/characters/survivor_<view>.png, pasted at (16, 20)) and frames 1-8 are the cycle. build_motion.py reads frames 1-8.

survivor-east.png.action: walking to the right, steady walk cycle, legs alternate stepping, arms swing gently, feet stay on the same ground line

survivor-south.png.action: walking towards the camera, steady walk cycle, legs alternate stepping, arms swing gently, feet stay on the same ground line

survivor-north.png.action: walking away from the camera, steady walk cycle, legs alternate stepping, arms swing gently, feet stay on the same ground line

survivor-west.png.action: walking to the left, steady walk cycle, legs alternate stepping, arms swing gently, feet stay on the same ground line
